attributes.name: Druva - Backup Storage Target Changed
attributes.description: Detects administrative changes to backup storage or destination settings.
author: Druva
false_positives: Planned migration to new backup storage.
attributes.query:
druva.feature:"Admin Event"
and druva.event_type:"Backup Storage Target Changed"
attributes.note:
### Investigation guide

This rule detects an administrative change to a Druva backup storage target. Unauthorized storage changes may interfere with future backup or recovery operations.

#### Investigation steps

- Identify the administrator and affected storage configuration.
- Determine the previous and new storage target where available.
- Confirm the destination is approved and reachable.
- Review backup success after the change.
- Review repository, retention, protection, permission, and recovery-target changes around the same period.
- Search for suspicious authentication, privilege, UDA, or ransomware activity.

#### Response

- Revert unauthorized storage changes.
- Validate subsequent backups and recovery availability.
- Investigate the responsible administrator when the modification cannot be explained.
